subject: 开封山陕甘会馆 · 木牌楼正面
author: Windmemories
source_note: Windmemories于2023年拍摄。五楼为一座高中央屋顶与两侧前后四座翼顶，后排部分遮挡；保留照片柱簇与石鼓位置，不强行展开为平面六柱。
prompt: Create one museum catalogue plate of the Qing wooden ceremonial paifang in Kaifeng Shan-Shaan-Gan Guild Hall, faithfully using image 2, with image 1 only as the fine contour drawing style master. Black hairline ink on pure white background, minimal restrained internal detail and no solid black areas, no color, no grey shading, no hatching. Isolate ONLY the central open wooden paifang, not the halls behind and beside it, not people, trees, lamps or modern things. Frontal centered elevation with a very slight upward view as photographed. The actual structure is three bays, six columns in two three-column triangular clusters (do not place six columns in one flat row), five roofs: one high central broad hipped-gable roof and four smaller wing roofs arranged front/back on both sides, with the rear pair partially occluded as in photo. Keep its distinctive sweeping wing roof ridges, brackets, central long narrow blank plaque, two narrower side bays and very wide center opening, stone drum braces against the columns and individual stone bases. Follow the visible geometry closely, including occlusions. Exclude the background hall roof visible through the center arch: center opening must be white. Render decoration as selective delicate curves, roof tile courses sparse; all wood, tiles and stone remain unfilled white. No lettering, no invented glyphs, no border. Complete crown and stone footings uncropped, ample white margins. Wide landscape plate. This is a documentation illustration, do not add invented architectural details.

site_recommendation.name: 开封山陕甘会馆
site_recommendation.lede: 高低错落的五座屋顶压在两组柱簇上，木雕与石础把商帮会馆的门面装点得细密。中间开阔的通道，让这座牌楼显得繁而通透。
facts: 会馆于清乾隆年间集资营建，1776是会馆创建沿革年，不直接认作牌楼确切完工年。
牌楼三间六柱五楼，柱子分成两组前后错落的支撑，并非六柱一字排开。
图版依2023年正面照片绘制木牌楼，后方殿宇与两侧廊房省略。
